prompts.name: Slate
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup and logo-brand. Create ONE polished visual direction for Bar-cal, a real native macOS menu-bar calendar. Direction name: SLATE. Target image canvas 1536x1024 landscape. Reference image attached: existing Bar-cal calendar screenshot; use ONLY its small native calendar scale, actual November 2026 calendar content, and compact utility interaction as functional grounding. Deliberately create a distinct new visual identity, not an Itsycal clone. The user explicitly prefers quiet native utility: compact, clean, keyboard-first. Current date is Friday November 13, 2026. Highlight 13 correctly in the Friday column; Nov 1 is Sunday. Composition: restrained design presentation on neutral graphite, with a large original macOS app icon at left and a beautifully crisp compact calendar popover at right, and a small monochrome rendition of the new mark to show menu-bar legibility. ONE concept, no alternative choices within the image. Icon: a unique abstract upright slab/offset bar monogram suggesting a marked day, precise negative-space notch and small warm-light highlight; no face, eyes, smile, calendar emoji, spiral binding, generic calendar-page icon, letters or numbers inside the icon. Rounded-square charcoal body, fine satin depth, subtle cool silver-blue edge. Silhouette should remain strong at 16 px, professional calm Apple-native utility. Theme: graphite and slate surfaces, warm off-white legible SF Pro-like text, a single restrained periwinkle accent for selected day and focus; no gradients behind UI, no glow, no neon, no decorative illustrations, no dashboard chrome. Calendar: month/year, clearly labeled Today, previous/next chevrons, weekday/date grid, subdued inactive dates, small native outline action icons along footer, one quiet empty-state sentence and Choose Calendars button. Keep calendar panel at natural narrow shape, about 340px wide by 560px tall in the image, generous whitespace in the surrounding presentation. Exact product title text: 'Bar-cal'. Optional small direction caption 'Slate'. Render production-quality UI with strong hierarchy, intentional spacing, no clipping or unnecessary cards, natural proportions. Do not copy upstream mascot or app icon.

prompts.name: Tide
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup and logo-brand. Design ONE original coherent visual direction for Bar-cal, a compact native macOS menu-bar calendar. Direction name TIDE. Canvas 1536x1024 landscape. Use attached Bar-cal screenshot only to ground the actual calendar functionality, compact proportions, restrained native controls, and information hierarchy. User style is quiet native utility, compact, clean, keyboard-first. Make a visibly distinct identity from original Itsycal: absolutely no face, mascot, cute eyes, calendar emoji, spiral binding, or red-topped calendar page. Current date Friday November 13, 2026. Correct November 2026 Sunday-start calendar starts at 1 on Sunday and highlights 13 on Friday. Composition: one beautiful app icon at left, one finished narrow calendar popover at right (roughly 340px wide by 560px tall, natural widget proportions), a small corresponding monochrome menu-bar glyph. Give balanced whitespace, no browser chrome, no device, no dashboard and no product feature inventory. Icon concept: a confident luminous jade/sea-glass circular day arc interrupted by a single upright rectangular marker, forming a distinctive simple recognizable silhouette, nested within a deep ink navy rounded-square macOS app icon. Bold clean geometry and crisp negative space, subtle material depth but no glowing light trails. No letters or numerals in the mark; designed to read at 16px in monochrome. Theme: deep inky blue surface, pale cool text, restrained sea-glass/jade selected-day fill and focus ring, subdued native controls, slight tonal section separation rather than outlined cards. No neon, cyberpunk, rainbow gradients, gradients behind UI, glass clutter or decorative texture. Calendar UI: month and year, Today button between chevrons, legible SF Pro-like type, clean grid with no heavy current-month border, dim inactive dates, slim new line action glyphs for add/pin/open/settings; one quiet setup message 'Choose calendars to see your day.' and 'Choose Calendars…' button. Exact title 'Bar-cal', optional small caption 'Tide'. Render production-quality readable UI and an icon with a genuinely new visual concept. Only one direction in this image.
